notes.envelope_rules_declared: module harness-view timeline/envelopes.rs: points anchored to the source sample (s = source_in + offset*rate; reversed: source_out - offset*rate), remapped into the edited clip, floor to tick; points outside 0..=duration dropped with a linear-in-dB interpolated edge point; a clip that did not exist before (razor right part, overwrite remnant) inherits from the old clip on the same audio track with the same source and speed whose span and source window contain it; removed clips lose theirs; rewritten set validated by Folio against the edited document (refusal refuses the edit: routing_invalid); entry absent / no envelope changed -> plain submit_sequence (entry byte-identical); entry invalid before the edit -> left as is, noted on the status line. Hooked in Viewer::timeline_commit (every timeline edit: trims, slip, slide, roll, razor, lift, ripple delete, move, nudges, trim session, rate stretch, speed/duration). Premiere/Audition behaviour UNVERIFIED (D5).
notes.track_automation_declared: Folio StudioTrackAutomation {track_id, param volume|pan, points [{offset_ticks from sequence start, value}]}, volume linear 0..=MAX_AUDIO_LEVEL, pan -1..=1, bounded MAX_TRACK_AUTOMATION_POINTS 4096, one lane per (track, param); unknown/non-audio/submix track InvalidId; absent list not serialized. Pulse: lane replaces the static volume/pan (volume linear in dB between points, held outside; muted submix stays at the floor; an audio track at static volume 0 with a volume lane plays). Track automation stays on the sequence timeline through clip edits (not rippled; UNVERIFIED vs Premiere/Audition).

run_ui_md_lines_for_lead: Multitrack (lane SMB-AU-MULTITRACK-2): the Volume and Pan lanes of audio and submix tracks are editable like Clip Volume: click adds a point, drag moves it, right click deletes it, one undo step each; volume is drawn in dB. Where a track has a lane, playback and mixdown follow the lane instead of the mixer fader / pan.

Timeline edits keep clip volume envelopes on their audio: trimming, slipping or rolling shifts or cuts the envelope (an edge point keeps the gain at the new edge), razor gives both parts their part of the envelope, lift and ripple delete remove it; undo restores clip and envelope together.
